image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large crocodile resting on a rocky surface. The head is prominent with an open mouth displaying sharp teeth. The skin texture is highly detailed with visible scutes and scales. The background consists of blurred earthy tones and rocks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly to a point, forming a clear V-shape characteristic of crocodiles rather than the U-shape of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is wide open in the image, so the condition 'visible when mouth is closed' cannot be verified. However, the teeth present are conical and numerous.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible on the top ridge of the skull (dorsal position). While pupil shape is hard to resolve perfectly at this resolution, the placement is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostril openings are clearly visible at the very end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct, raised rectangular scutes are visible running along the back/neck area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of olive-green and grey-brown with a very rough, pebbled texture consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The belly (ventral surface) is completely occluded by the ground/rock the animal is resting on.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in the frame; the body is low to the ground and cropped.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame; only the head and anterior trunk are shown.
